title: Headless branch: Boulder City Showdown ended by force (VMS20 100, outcome 4: the Khans killed), and They Went That-a-Way goes on through Jessup's note (VMQ01 100, VMQTops 10)

actions.text: Starts as boulder-city.actions.json does (after Novac, VMQ01 at 50). The player walks into Boulder City and offers Monroe to deal with the Khans (VMS20 10).

In the ruins the player opens fire on Jessup's gang instead of talking (StartCombat stands in for the first shot: the Khans' OnStartCombat marks them hostile, VMS20 objective 50), then kills the six Khans of the gang, Jessup among them (combat stand-in: kill with the player as killer). Their OnDeath counts nDeathsGreatKhans; the sixth death ends VMS20 at 100 with outcome 4.
With Jessup dead his Benny line is gone; the way on is the note he carries. The player loots his body: VMQ01's script sees the note (GetHasNote), ends VMQ01 at 100 and starts VMQTops at 10.
VMQ01's script runs at the quest's processing delay (5 s by default), so the note is seen within 5 s.
